mechanism.rationale: Spectral concentration modulates a population prior; it is not a physical pulse law or calibrated confidence. ECG supplies an independent sensor target.

novelty.rationale: Primary-source analyses and established equation families are disclosed. This review does not establish exhaustive literature novelty or a new universal law.

reproducibility.rationale: Exact task, equation/state, group evidence, native semantics and provenance inspected; separate computational review is responsible for complete replay.

impact.rationale: No independent deployment, intervention, cost saving or clinical/industrial acceptance outcome was measured.
